managementGroupId.description: Optional: crawl only the hierarchy beneath this management group

subscriptionIds.description: Optional: limit the crawl to these subscription IDs

includeResourceLevel.description: Also enumerate individual resources (high volume) — off by default

includeCustomRoles.description: Resolve tenant custom role definitions, not just built-in roles

onlyEntraPrincipals.description: Only load assignments for principals present in Entra ID. On: skip role assignments whose principal isn't in the crawled Entra directory (run the Entra ID crawler first). Off: load them but flag the principal as orphaned.
